LNBP (Mexico, with COPA VALUE and LNBP FEMENIL) (Atrium shortcuts)

Source: R/atrium_competitions.R
lnbp_competition.Rd

Per-competition shortcuts over the Atrium embed API for LNBP (Mexico, with COPA VALUE and LNBP FEMENIL) (website_id = 14; men's and women's).

Thin bindings of the parameterised atrium_*() wrappers to this site, minted from the competition registry (sdv-py tools/codegen/basketball_competitions.yaml); the full surface stays on the atrium_*() wrappers.

Usage

lnbp_seasons(locale = NULL)
lnbp_schedule(season = NULL, season_id = NULL, competition_id = NULL, locale = NULL)
lnbp_standings(season = NULL, season_id = NULL, competition_id = NULL, locale = NULL)
lnbp_teams(season = NULL, season_id = NULL, competition_id = NULL, locale = NULL)
lnbp_player_box(fixture_id, locale = NULL)
lnbp_team_box(fixture_id, locale = NULL)
lnbp_pbp(fixture_id, locale = NULL)
lnbp_shots(fixture_id, locale = NULL)

Arguments

season

(integer optional): Season END year (season rule below). Omit season and season_id for the site's current season.

season_id

(character optional): Season UUID (season_id in the seasons listing); skips the END-year lookup.

competition_id

(character optional): Competition UUID (a site carries many: conferences, cups); needed when several share the season.

locale

(character optional): Label locale, e.g. "en-EN"; omitted = the site's own language.

fixture_id

(character required): Fixture UUID (fixture_id in the schedule).

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with the columns of the base wrapper, one table per function:

The columns of atrium_seasons():

col_nametypedescription
website_idintegerSite config id the body came from (12 LNB, 14 LNBP, 3 NBL1, 13 El Salvador, 22 Panama, 236 Austria, 326 Montenegro), read from the body's links.self.
season_idcharacterSeason UUID; pass it as season_id to any season-scoped wrapper.
competition_idcharacterCompetition UUID; pass it as competition_id to pick one of several seasons of an END year.
competition_namecharacterCompetition name in the site's language; the same name can appear for several years.
season_namecharacterSeason name in the site's language, e.g. Betclic ELITE 2025.
abbreviation_localcharacterLocal abbreviation of the season; null in every body seen.
yearintegerThe site's own year of the season: the START year on LNB (site 12), the calendar year elsewhere.
season_end_yearintegerSeason END year (the sdv key): the site's year + 1 on LNB (site 12), the calendar year on the other registered sites; null when the site is unregistered, lists no seasons or the body has no season list.
is_default_seasonlogicalTrue for the season the body is about (the site's default when none was asked).

lnbp_pbp()

The columns of atrium_pbp():

col_nametypedescription
website_idintegerSite config id the body came from (12 LNB, 14 LNBP, 3 NBL1, 13 El Salvador, 22 Panama, 236 Austria, 326 Montenegro), read from the body's links.self.
fixture_idcharacterGame UUID (fixture); the key of every game frame and of the fixture_detail routes.
season_idcharacterSeason UUID of the game.
sequenceinteger1-based position of the event in the game (periods in order, events chronological).
event_idcharacterEvent UUID, shared with the same event in atrium_shots.
period_idintegerPeriod number: 1-4 regulation, 11, 12, ... overtimes (not 5).
clockcharacterTime REMAINING in the period as an ISO 8601 duration (PT10M0S at the start).
clock_secondsintegerSeconds remaining in the period, parsed from clock.
entity_idcharacterTeam UUID the event is credited to.
sidecharacterSide of the game the row belongs to: home or away (from the fixture's isHome flag).
person_idcharacterPlayer UUID; null for team events (time-outs, team rebounds).
person_namecharacterPlayer the event is credited to; null for team events (time-outs, team rebounds).
bibcharacterJersey number of the player, as text; null for team events.
event_typecharacterEvent type: 2pt, 3pt, freeThrow, rebound, assist, steal, block, turnover, foul, substitution, timeOut, jumpBall, ... (language-independent).
event_sub_typecharacterEvent detail: jumpShot, layup, offensive, defensive, in, out, 1Of2, personal, ...; null when none.
descriptioncharacterThe event's text in the site's language (e.g. Entre-deux remporte).
successlogicalTrue when a shot or free throw was made, false when missed; null for other events.
success_labelcharacterThe made / missed label in the site's language; sent on shot events only.
xdoubleShot location along the 28 m court length as percent of the court (0-100, origin at a corner); the home team attacks the low-x basket all game; null for non-shots.
ydoubleShot location across the 15 m width as percent of the court (0-100); which sideline is 0 is unverified; null for non-shots.
home_scoreintegerHome team's running score after the event.
away_scoreintegerAway team's running score after the event.

away_scoreintegerAway team's running score after the event.

Details

Season rule: calendar year.

Errors and terms of use are those of atrium_fixtures(): unofficial use of the public widget endpoint, at least 1 s between requests, not republished as release assets. The site also serves women's competitions (pass their competition_id).

 lnbp_seasons()
 lnbp_schedule()
